evidence:
Source-level row-39 reasoning passes; no configured floor score is claimed. The actual workbook Quality Checks row 39 (A40:D40) and internal annotation call for a near-zero floor for blank/static/mock/seed-copy/keyword-stuffed/refusing submissions; the skill reference at quality-checks.md:161-163 explicitly asks to reason through those cases and excludes CDN fetches. Frozen task tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires failed-password then successful sign-in into a usable workspace. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-25 additionally requires UI creation of a uniquely identified requisition and PENDING offer, their association and values, then operational UI retrieval in an independent empty context; it explicitly rejects static seed responses, no-op successes, browser-only mutations and requisition-only apps. Thus a blank/refusing page fails the gates; convincing static/seed-copy/keyword pages cannot substitute existing records for the fresh writes; a localStorage-only fake loses those writes in the new context. Untrusted-content language at each prompt's opening prevents keyword instructions from earning criterion credit.

The failure propagates to the actual reward rather than leaving appearance credit: test.sh:212-224 runs gates, invokes score.py, and exits before scored on gate failure. score.py:40-48 requires both gate scores above zero and functional above 0.05, otherwise reward=0. All scored prompts separately zero a nonworking shell (functional:9-11, polish:7-8, visual:7-8); visual uses raw Likert 1 and explicitly states that this normalizes to zero. The three shared scoring files are byte-identical to the frozen template. Frozen functional criteria have 145 rows, total weight 45; merely refusing approval/revision/rescission does not earn those negative checks because they require their successful action controls. Polish likewise requires real successful operations/recovery, not failure messages alone.

Broken alternative examined: the no_op_create fixture returns HTTP200/created:true while saving no requisition (local/gate-witness.cjs:10,20-30); its raw results show reqSaved=false, offerSaved=false, freshReq=false and freshOffer=false. A static health or success response therefore is insufficient. Conforming alternatives examined: an initially empty operational app, generated IDs, absent separate title/department controls, equivalent date/money display, alternate routes/layout and browser CDN assets are explicitly accepted by instruction.md:5,9,11 and constraints judge:23-25. These alternatives do not trigger the floor. The dead_approval fixture retains genuine shared intake and passes the minimal scripted prerequisite; that is legitimate partial functionality and must be assessed by independently controlled scored criteria, not treated as a blank app. No conforming-app floor failure was found from these source checks.

Raw-evidence integrity: all 317 entries in the current index were independently rehashed with no mismatch; index SHA256=4df30797f063a8b5373cdc0749b01caadaeec4c0df5a75faf1241a02704ae3d9. Own verification is per-row-review/evidence/39/hash-verification.json. Gate witness source SHA256=08ee689584d24a97a8446fb32ca0c4f9d3df100bd6eec14560c4fa63ad8ae31c; results SHA256=fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75; log SHA256=1c63a7bb4e868a981b21f7df7e98531aedb5d921cf890f239ea71bd93ec33706. This script observes UI identity/pending persistence and no-op rejection; it does not measure every field in the gate or a configured judge's verdict.

Risk remains true: the raw index explicitly states that full configured grading/workload and empirical app reward discrimination/ranking are absent. No configured blank/static/seed-copy/refusing floor score, Oracle score, target-model score or portal outcome has been measured here. The source-level Pass must not waive the required missing runtime records under qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md and qc/README.md. No provider calls, new Docker runs or frozen-source edits were performed.
